Dangerous Goods

Instrucción de embalaje

A specific regulatory code or set of detailed requirements issued by authorities (e.g. IATA, IMDG, ADR) dictating the permitted packaging methods for dangerous goods shipments.

Quick answer: A specific regulatory code or set of detailed requirements issued by authorities (e.g. IATA, IMDG, ADR) dictating the permitted packaging methods for dangerous goods shipments.

Quick answer

Why it matters

Instrucción de embalaje matters because it supports clear communication in Dangerous Goods contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Instrucción de embalaje?

In this glossary, Instrucción de embalaje refers to: A specific regulatory code or set of detailed requirements issued by authorities (e.g. IATA, IMDG, ADR) dictating the permitted packaging methods for dangerous goods shipments.

How is Instrucción de embalaje used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Cada envío de mercancías peligrosas debe cumplir con la instrucción de embalaje aplicable según el Reglamento de Mercancías Peligrosas de IATA."

Why does Instrucción de embalaje matter in logistics?

Instrucción de embalaje matters because it supports clear communication in Dangerous Goods contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Instrucción de embalaje?

Instrucción de embalaje is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Instrucción de embalaje belong to?

In this glossary, Instrucción de embalaje is grouped under Dangerous Goods. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A specific regulatory code or set of detailed requirements issued by authorities (e.g. IATA, IMDG, ADR) dictating the permitted packaging methods for dangerous goods shipments.

Operational example

Each dangerous goods consignment must comply with the applicable packing instruction as listed in the IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations.

Localized term

Instrucción de embalaje

Localized example

Cada envío de mercancías peligrosas debe cumplir con la instrucción de embalaje aplicable según el Reglamento de Mercancías Peligrosas de IATA.
